hi.text: Hm. You came a long way for a field. Most don't bother.

hollow.text: Rock, mostly. And quiet. Stand in the middle of it sometime and you'll see what I mean.

errand.text: Walk into the hollow for me. All the way to the middle. My knees don't do rock anymore, and I like knowing someone's been.

thanks.text: Good. Mind the gap on the east side, the rocks are loose.
